findings.evidence: `grep -r maximalFunction TauCeti/` matches only TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Integral/MaximalFunction.lean, so nothing consumes the new map; no Calderón–Zygmund file exists under TauCeti/ (Lane B.10 unstarted); Lebesgue differentiation is in ./mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Covering/Differentiation.lean; the PR description itself justifies the work as 'improves the existing ... API', not as progress on a target.
findings.fix: Name the downstream roadmap item that requires a map on the Lp quotient (Lane B.10 / E.21 consume the pointwise and eLpNorm estimates), or drop the quotient map and its three lemmas and keep only the representative-level facts `ae_maximalFunction_lt_top_of_memLp` and `memLp_maximalFunction_toReal`.
findings.issue: `maximalFunctionLp`, `coeFn_maximalFunctionLp`, `coeFn_maximalFunctionLp_toLp`, `enorm_maximalFunctionLp_le` are new periphery around a target whose own statement is already done: the weak (1,1) and strong (p,p) bounds are pre-PR (`eLpNorm_maximalFunction_le`, line 553, unchanged apart from its docstring), and target 8's Lebesgue-differentiation corollary comes from Mathlib. The bundling into a bare nonlinear map on the Lp quotient does not bring the target or any later target closer.

summary: Lane B target 8 is already fully proved on main, and this PR adds quotient-level packaging around that finished estimate with no in-repo or roadmap-named consumer. Single topic is fine; the advancement claim is not.
